definitions.ask: Which note should own meet.md once it becomes the Meetings notebook?
definitions.why: Keeps meeting notes beside unattributed meetings, like legacy_inbox under inbox

choices.label: Catalog in meet_inbox.md lists Meetings, with Legacy meet notes nested under it
Catalog in gtd.md lists Meetings beside GTD ideas; meet_inbox.md gets no catalog
Catalog in job.md lists it, though job.md covers job searches and many meetings are personal

definitions.ask: Should chezmoi's bob config pin gcal.root to meet_inbox so hosts on an older bob keep a valid root?
definitions.why: Vault sync reaches every host in minutes; when each host rebuilds bob is unknown

choices.label: Live root line; every host is right on its next chezmoi apply, though it repeats the default
Only the commented example changes; hosts on an older bob write rootless rows until rebuilt

definitions.ask: Should built-in review_time stop counting MEET minutes now that default-rooted meetings sit under gtd?
definitions.why: review_time already counts every gtd-tree minute, bob project work included

choices.label: Unchanged; meetings rooted at meet_inbox count as gtd review time until you re-root them
Built-in review_time gains exclude_themes MEET; docs/stats.md and registry tests change

definitions.ask: Should the Inbox File glossary strand list meet_inbox.md as an inbox file that roots default Event Tasks?
Should a new decisions strand record that meet.md is a notebook and Event Tasks default to meet_inbox?
